title: RGAA audit
description: Input format of RGAA Audit Viewer: the result of an RGAA audit, page by page and criterion by criterion. Extra properties are allowed and ignored by the viewer.

date.description: Audit date, usually YYYY-MM-DD. Shown in the header and in agent prompts; part of the audit identity used to store done states.

reference_framework.description: Name and version of the reference framework. Shown in the header and in agent prompts. Defaults to "RGAA" when missing.

audited_pages.description: Informative. The viewer counts the pages itself from the "pages" array.

environment.description: Free key/value pairs describing the audit environment (tools, browser versions). Shown in the header and in agent prompts.

summary.description: Optional per-page summary. Ignored by the viewer, which recomputes every count from "pages".

pages.description: Audited pages, in the order they should be listed.

url.description: URL of the audited page. Its path and query string identify the page (the host is ignored); a value that is not a valid URL is used as is.

audited_at.description: Timestamp of the page audit (ISO 8601 recommended). Shown in agent prompts; part of the audit identity used to store done states.

criteria.description: One result per RGAA criterion. Every page should list the same criteria.

number.description: Criterion number. Must be a string so that "3.10" is not read as 3.1. Results without a number are skipped; a duplicated number on the same page keeps its first result.

topic.description: Topic of the criterion. The first value found for a given number is used on every page.

title.description: Title of the criterion. The first value found for a given number is used on every page.

status.description: Result of the criterion on the page. Only "non_compliant" and "to_verify" entries can be marked as done and get agent prompts. The viewer also tolerates other values: they are displayed as is and cannot be marked.

method.description: How the result was obtained. Known values get a readable label; other values are displayed as is.

finding.description: What was observed on the page.

affected_elements.description: CSS selectors of the elements concerned.

faulty_code.description: Code captured on the page, usually an HTML fragment on one line; "…" or "..." marks truncated parts. Entries sharing the same faulty code are grouped in the all-pages agent prompt.
